items.title: Your CV's hobbies section is usually dead code
items.pt:
TL;DR



"Reading, socialising, travelling" is on roughly a million CVs and signals nothing except that you filled a section
Keep hobbies only if you are early-career or short on experience, and make every line specific enough to hint at commitment
Everything you list is fair game in the interview, so never put down something you cannot talk about with real enthusiasm

items.title: AI Citations Are a Closed Loop: 15 Domains, ~68% of All Answers
items.pt:
If you publish technical content in 2026, one number should reorganize your strategy: fifteen domains capture roughly 68% of every citation that ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews produce.

The number comes from the AI Citation Source Index 2026, which ranks the fifty most-cited domains in AI answers, synthesized from six independent studies covering 680M+ citations (Everything-PR, updated August 2026).

items.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
items.pt: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules. To reliably construct and interact with 3D worlds, our framework jointly models three native world states: physics (gravity field and latitude), geometry (depth), and appearance (image), together with a unified Omni-Camera representation that supports diverse tasks and flexible motions. items.title: Last Translation Benchmark
items.pt: For scientific progress, we need benchmarks that test the limits of state-of-the-art models, and evaluation methods that inform us about failure cases. As models get stronger, standard benchmarks for machine translation are approaching saturation.
